title: Penalty lateness threshold is defined and retrievable
gherkin:
Given a rental system with penalty lateness threshold configuration
When the penalty lateness threshold is queried
Then a threshold value or formula must be returned
And the threshold must be expressed in a measurable unit (minutes, hours, or days)
rationale: Verifies that the penalty lateness threshold exists as a defined, retrievable configuration. This is the foundational requirement—without a defined threshold, penalty application cannot be consistently determined.
usedContextItems: Penalty lateness threshold must be defined to determine when late-return penalties apply

rationale: Establishes the boundary condition at the threshold. Returns at exactly the threshold time should not incur penalties, defining the inclusive/exclusive nature of the threshold boundary.
